A pilgrim choir is passing through; custom says townsfolk greet it dressed in holy-light garb.
Rumor says the wind spirit festival, where people parade in light wind-blessed garb, is moved up; unconfirmed.
Figures seen at night in the old graveyard; if the dead are walking, only blades of purifying light will do.
A bard's new song about a black-clad knight makes dark-colored helmets and armor fashionable.
A flame dance troupe is coming; spectators traditionally wear flame-shaped sashes and belts.
The royal council passed a new tax on armor trading.
The crown created a bounty for monster hunting, drawing new adventurers who first need something to fight with.
A gold strike in {region} fills adventurers' purses and hunt rewards rise.
A major money changer closed; adventurers' cash is short and pricey purchases are put off.
A nearby village's watch decides to outfit its members with protective gear after night injuries.
Flooding brought slippery water monsters into village fields; heavy crushing blows are said to work.
